cases.name: Leslie Liceth Ruiz Basilio
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She received her early education in the public schools of Mayanalan and later on went on to obtain her GED. Upon learning she was soon to be a mother, she became employed by Metro PCS as a store associate. She excelled and went on to become a manager of her store with hopes of one day opening her own store. She was a member of the Catholic community in which she contributed and helped. She loved life and lived every day to the fullest. She did this by dancing, she loved exercising by doing Zumba. Loved singing and would often been seeing going out to her favorite restaurants to sing, eat, and dance. She will be remembered as someone who welcomed everyone with a cold Corona Premier in one hand and lending out the other. Most importantly, she leaves her mark on the world as someone happy and full of life."
cases.narrative: He entered the Metro by T-Mobile store where she worked in Elsmere, DE and dragged her to the back of the store and shot her in the head.
